desc: Derive the exact minimum-cost characterization, including a proof of optimality.
Validate the descending-largest greedy formula against exhaustive exact optima for small permutations and the provided examples.
Compute the proven formula in \(O(N\log N)\) with a Fenwick tree over original positions.

Check integer bounds and final input/output behavior.
